brief: UBS sales and trading flags the SOX's bounce off DeMark support near 9,047, with 70% of constituents near a DeMark buy signal, as the catalyst for a broader semiconductor-led rally that keeps the S&P 500 on track for an 8,485 target next year and lifts the Nasdaq given each index's semiconductor weighting. Fresh SOX gains beyond 10,498 would open 10,878, 11,711 and 12,756. Separately, UBS argues against chasing the recent US 2y and 10y Treasury yield bounce, since pending lower-yield DeMark signals (one due around month end, November 30) should cap it. VIX and MOVE gains are read as corrective within a longer-term downtrend, supporting an extended risk rally. UBS also says don't chase EURUSD downside (near a cyclical low) and treats gold pullbacks as buying opportunities, with gold miners basing too. It expects a broader European equity recovery (Euro Stoxx 50, tech, retail), a bullish KOSPI reversal, a cautious Japan pending a 62,315 reclaim, a constructive Nifty targeting new highs, a bearish WTI topping call, and continued recovery in US consumer discretionary, REITs, real estate, homebuilders and airlines.
